notes.title: Big Tutorial Bug – Fix Coming Today!
notes.content:
[p]Hey!

Here’s a quick update to let you know that we just realized there’s a BIG bug in the tutorial.

Right now, the game tutorial is broken and only gives the player “Deck Gosts” (whereas normally, the player gets trolls, and this breaks their inventory for the rest of the game).

This is due to a mistake on our part and I’m really sorry about it. Really, it’s my fault — I messed up.
(And since, in the tutorial, the player also talks about “Deck Gosts,” I think new players probably just thought the tutorial was supposed to be like that and that the game was therefore super hard.) 
Anyway, we were really unlucky with this one.[/p][p]In any case, I’ll fix this today — I’m truly sorry for the incident.
[/p][p]In other news, the next update with the continuation of the story is coming at the beginning of the month! And that will be the start of Part 4, which will be the last part of the game before the ending ~[/p][p]
So yeah, sorry again — we’re fixing this today![/p]

notes.title: Porn and Cards: PART 2
notes.content:
[i]Hello everyone![/i] The Part 2 is here !!
New faces, new stories, new battles, and more NSFW stuff! 🪄❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061231/caf3c8a4975c19b267226baea31d6c4182d77f10.gif[/img]

[h3]Changelog[/h3] 
What's new in town:
[h3]🌠 Story Progression[/h3]  
The tale continues with part 2! 
New scenes, fresh dialogue, and deeper mysteries unfold in the dusty town of Lucky Valley.
[h3]🤠 Two New Characters Ride In[/h3]  
Two brand-new personalities make their entrance, each with their own secrets... and temptations. (On top of the Sheriff you’ve already met.)
[h3]🔥 More NSFW Content[/h3]  
Things are getting steamier!~ New intimate scenes have been added for your… exploration.
[h3]⚔️ New Battles & Card Units[/h3]  
Expect tougher duels and new units to command on the battlefield. Plan smart, shoot fast.
[h3]📜 Quest Panel Added[/h3]  
A brand-new panel: track your progress and replay unlocked NSFW scenes whenever the mood strikes.

[h3]🔧 Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
- AI now makes smarter tactical choices.  
- Special cards no longer get counted as played when they’re not.  
- Damage previews now correctly calculate movement and results, especially in tutorial missions.  
- Opponent’s HP display is now in the right place (no more floating ghost numbers).  
- UI blur effects, highlights, and transitions now behave properly across menus and scenes.  
- Cards now appear and disappear when they should—no more ghost cards stuck in your hand.  
- Inventory and menu transitions have been smoothed out.  
- Live2D animations now loop only when intended and no longer restart at random.  
- Context stack issues fixed when jumping around during combat.  
- Starting a New Game no longer gives you your old deck back from another timeline.  
- Mouse cursor now reliably appears when opening menus during animations.  
- Visual glitches with card placements, team mirroring, and spot highlights have been fixed.  
- Saving is now disabled during fights to avoid cursed save files.  
- Various animation, UI and performance fixes for a smoother ride through Lucky Valley.

📝 Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback!  
This update lays the groundwork for even more stories, wild west NSFW scenes, and spicy surprises coming your way soon.

The next chapter of PnC is already in the works — stay sharp, and keep your deck ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061231/2c4b039b02f5717ef9809f4138bba0ffd3c55355.png[/img]

notes.title: Part 1 Rework Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h3]

Today on Steam, for the first update of our beloved PnC, we have completely reworked the first part of the game.
Many dialogues have been changed, and part of the storyline as well!

As I mentioned in previous news, we had to make some adjustments to better align with our new vision for the game.
But don’t worry—everything we originally planned is still there! The different romances, the intrigues, and the overall storyline remain the same in broad strokes. However, some details, like Daisy’s relationship with the player, had to be adjusted.
(And personally, I like it much more now!)

We’ve also fixed a lot of bugs and completely revamped the save system. So, between the updated story and the recoded save system, old saves will no longer work!
Now is the perfect time to start a new game!
This shouldn’t happen again in the future, but this change was really necessary.
[h3][b]
About the next update: Part 2[/b][/h3]

Well, it’s already finished and will be available on Steam in four weeks!
We’re already working on the next one—Part 3 (Yes, I know, we’re efficient! 😉)

If you have any feedback, whether it’s about bugs or just to share your thoughts on the game, feel free to comment on this post or on the Steam forums—I’ll be happy to reply!

Enjoy the game, and see you soon!
Salty

notes.title: Newsletter Part2 of Porn and Cards !
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today, a brand-new newsletter with a LOT of announcements and changes!
Alright, I'll try to keep it simple, so let's get straight to the point!

Well... We've decided to rework the game's introduction.

As I explained before, the game was initially meant to be more of a romance game, with an adult DLC unlocking NSFW scenes.
That didn’t work out. ~~ :D

SO, we’re back to "P*rn & Cards", and the game is now fully NSFW, as originally planned.

BUT, the storyline I had written was designed for a romance game.
It had drama, emotional intrigue, jealousy, and relationship struggles...

And well, that doesn’t really fit an NSFW game.
So, I have to go back to the original concept and bring back the same tone as OPT1 and OPT2.
(Yep, lots of lessons learned—"sometimes going back is better.")

So, I rewrote the entire game script with MAJOR changes to the characters and overall tone.
It took some time, but it was necessary to make a solid NSFW game.

So, In the next update, you’ll get:
✅ The fully rewritten first part of the game
✅ Part 2 of the game
✅ New scenes & dialogues
✅ New battles
✅ The arrival of the Sheriff
✅ Another brand-new character making their first appearance!
✅ The quest board, which also works as a scene gallery!

Yeah, lots of new content.
I’m doing my best to wrap everything up as soon as possible.

As you've seen in-game, we're starting a comic on our networks! 
[b][i]Emee's Adventures in the Galactic Wild West! [/i][/b]
Go check it out, it's pretty cool and gives you a glimpse of what's happening with Emee and OPT during Porn and Cards! (And the story will connect to the game and everything, which is pretty cool.)

[u][b][url=https://x.com/SaltyGameDev01]https://x.com/SaltyGameDev01[/url][/b][/u]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45061231/2affb13ad4d29644ea6daa96d2a50718e92a63c6.jpg[/img]

AND, we've now increased the publication rate to 1 page per week!!
It's a huge workload, but the artist handling the comic is super motivated, so we’re going for this new release rhythm. ( But I'll tell you more about it later in another post dedicated to this subject )
Pretty cool, right?

I hope you all have a great day, and I'll see you very soon for the update!

Bye ~~

And most importantly, as you may have noticed, the game has changed its name!

Goodbye [strike]Love and Cards[/strike] hello [b]Porn and Cards[/b]!~~

We've decided to focus more on the NSFW aspect, so the game now includes the NSFW version by default! No need for an extra DLC anymore~

See you later ~~
